backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.body: A backup contains settings, POI files, the curated catalog, download history and all messages (the Board and encrypted channels, which stay encrypted). Maps, books, models and other large content are not included; copy the data folder for those. Keep backups private.
backup.restoreBody: Restoring replaces settings, the curated catalog and POI files with the same names right away (other POI files are kept). Messages and download history are replaced when Fyr restarts.
backup.restart: Restart Fyr (for Docker: {command}) to finish restoring {items}. Until then the old messages stay in use.
backup.confirm:
Restore "{name}"?

This replaces the current settings, curated catalog and matching POI files now, and all messages and download history after the next restart. Take a backup first if you may want them back.
